description.value:
You touch a droid, construct, or creature with a tech focus, which must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or be afflicted with a tech-based curse for the duration. Choose the curse's effect when you cast the power: disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws with one chosen ability score; disadvantage on the target's attack rolls against you; a repeated Intelligence saving throw at the start of each of the target's turns, wasting its action on a failure; or your attacks and powers deal an extra 1d8 lightning damage to the target.

A remove virus power ends this effect, and the GM may substitute a different curse of comparable power.

Cast with a tech slot of 4th level or higher, the duration becomes concentration, up to 10 minutes; with a slot of 5th level or higher, 8 hours without requiring concentration; with a slot of 7th level or higher, 24 hours; and with a 9th-level slot, the curse lasts until dispelled.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 3
